name: embedding_sparse_backward
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::embedding_sparse_backward(Tensor grad, Tensor indices, int num_weights, int padding_idx, bool scale_grad_by_freq) -> Tensor. Builds a sparse embedding weight gradient from dense output gradients and integer indices. Tests cover batch, sequence, embedding and table sizes, padding indices, supported floating dtypes, sparse layout, and dense-equivalent values.
